<div class="bg-secondary">
  <div class="container text-white py-5">

    <div class="row">
      <div class="col-12 mb-3">
        <h1 class="text-left">Guesthouse.</h1>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
      <div class="col-md-6">
        <p class="mb-3 psjustify">Hello and welcome to our hotel — or as we say in Brazil, “pousada” — on Ilha do Guajiru. With steady winds over 20 knots, 30°C air temperature, 27°C water temperature, and plenty of sunshine, we're happy to welcome you to one of Brazil’s best kitesurfing spots — 7 Beaufort Brazil.</p>
        <p class="psjustify">Ilha do Guajiru is the perfect kitespot for all skill levels: in the huge flatwater lagoon right at your doorstep, you can easily learn to kite, work on new tricks, boost into big airs, or take a short walk across the sandbank at the far end of the lagoon to dive into the waves of the open sea. Or join us on a downwinder to nearby kite destinations.<br />
The best part: our hotel is located right at the kitespot of Ilha do Guajiru – you can basically kite straight out of bed! Our kite school, right on the lagoon, makes your vacation especially hassle-free.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <p class="mb-3 psjustify">Unwind after your kitesurf session at our restaurant with bar — offering a stunning view of the kite lagoon. Enjoy a refreshing açaí bowl or a delicious caipirinha and let the day wind down in a relaxed atmosphere. At 7 Beaufort, you’ll find a big family of like-minded people — always open to new encounters and great conversations.<br />
The pool, right next to the kite school, invites you to cool off, while a foosball table and a pool table ensure plenty of fun and variety. Boredom? Not a chance here!</p>
        <p class="psjustify">Whether you're alone, with friends, or with family – you're always welcome here! 7 Beaufort is more than just a kitespot: here you'll find new friends, amazing experiences, and a true zest for life. Your home in Brazil!</p>
        <div class="d-flex justify-content-end">
          <a class="btn btn-outline-light" href="rooms.html">Rooms</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row mb-4">
      <div class="col-md-6">
        <h4>100% wind safety</h4>
        <p class="psjustify">Between mid-June and mid-January, Ilha do Guajiru offers nearly 100% wind reliability. And that's not the only reason why the kite lagoon is one of the best kitespots in Brazil.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <h4>Kite school right at the spot</h4>
        <p class="psjustify">Our hotel, with an on-site kite school, is located right on the kite lagoon in Ilha do Guajiru, front row. That means you can start kiting right in front of your room.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
      <div class="col-md-6">
        <h4>In the heart of Ilha do Guajiru</h4>
        <p class="psjustify" >7 Beaufort Brazil is located right in the heart of the small village of Ilha do Guajiru. You can easily walk everywhere — and kite right at your doorstep.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <h4>Familiar kite community</h4>
        <p class="psjustify">We’re not just a place to sleep or an anonymous kite station — we’re a family of like-minded people who love kitesurfing and warmly welcome every guest.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
      <div class="col-12 mb-3">
        <h1 class="text-left">Best kite spot in Brazil.</h1>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row">
      <div class="col-md-6">
        <p class="psjustify">We believe that Ilha do Guajiru is the best kitespot in Brazil. Why? Because you can stay right at the spot, the kite season offers unmatched wind reliability compared to any other country, and the lagoon provides a safe environment for all skill levels. With consistently strong winds between 23 and 30 knots, along with a vast flatwater and rock-free area, everyone gets their money’s worth here.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <p class="psjustify">Our lagoon is about 5 km long and 700 meters wide, offering plenty of space for beginner lessons or to quietly practice a new trick. Convinced?</p>
